title: PremiumTick
description: Phase 4: a single premium observation for an option contract. Streamed from market-data-svc and signalled into PositionWorkflow.chandelier_tick. retrieved_at is the wire-time stamp from the source-of-truth feed.

contract_symbol.description: OCC option symbol the tick is for.

premium.description: Premium per contract, dollars. Source-of-truth field for the chandelier trail comparison. For chandelier-trail comparisons, market-data-svc fills this with the mid (bid+ask)/2 smoothed over a 5-10s window, not the last-trade price.

bid.description: Live NBBO bid per contract, dollars. Source-of-truth for the watchlist-trigger premium stop/target TRIGGER: a long option is exited at the bid (the price it can actually sell into), so the -1R stop and +2R target are evaluated against this, not the smoothed mid. A bid of 0 means no live bid (unexitable except by exercise). Optional/absent for back-compat with pre-bid tick producers and histories; consumers that require it fall back to `premium` (mid) when absent and audit the degradation.

ask.description: Live NBBO ask per contract, dollars. Carried alongside `bid` so a consumer can compute the spread and reject a blown/illiquid book. Optional/absent for back-compat.

retrieved_at.description: RFC3339 UTC timestamp when the tick was observed by the source feed.
